response.description: User lookup for autocompletion: finds people by name, nickname or numeric identifier and returns identifier-label pairs. The search starts from three characters, or immediately for a numeric query. Changes nothing.

params.input: Search string: part of a name, a nickname or the numeric user identifier
params.term: Same as input: the name the autocompletion sends the search string under
params.no_id: 1 — return labels without the numeric user identifier
params.full_search: 1 — search every profile field, not only the visible ones; always available to a site administrator
params.obj_type: Type of the object the search is limited to: project, community, conversation and other site object types
params.obj_id: Object ID: only its members are returned
